title: Shopper
slide_intent: Show how to vary the size of an identifier with the area available on a carried or worn object.
strategic_value: Repeating the carrot at two scales can identify a shopper discreetly on clothing and visibly on a delivery bag.
demonstration: Two photographs put a small carrot at a white shirt pocket and an enlarged, cropped carrot on a dark green tote.
practical_value: Compare the shirt and bag before sizing a mark. Reserve the broad tote panel for the larger graphic.

content_islands.name: Shirt application
content_islands.spec: Use the left half for a front view of the shirt. Keep the small colored mark aligned to the pocket.

content_islands.name: Bag application
content_islands.spec: Use the right half for the shopper carrying the bag. Place the large green and orange device low on the bag face.
